nonBlockingObservations.title: Name CI-3L explicitly in D4-4 dependency tracking
nonBlockingObservations.description: The plan correctly requires CI-A3 acceptance and its launch-member operation, but the dependency row names CI-3 without naming the separate CI-3L implementation unit. CI-A3-r1 section CI-A3-f and its interaction section explicitly put the operation in CI-3L after CI-2/CI-3. Thus CI-3 integration plus amendment acceptance alone will not supply the operation. The existing requirement to use that operation already prevents a valid D4-4 implementation from bypassing it, so this is a tracking clarification.
nonBlockingObservations.requestedChange: When carrying this plan into the unit scopes/status dependencies, list CI-3L implementation/integration explicitly beside CI-A3 acceptance, and retain the dependency if the separately reviewed amendment changes its unit name or interface.

rulings.Q1: Accepted at plan level. The two charged u32 buffers, fallible charged merge-sort comparisons, adjacent duplicate pass, policy-order checks, binary-search probes including explicit trust, both predicate passes and exact result allocation supply the missing accounting recipe. The reserved-slice allocation is charged in D4-2 and the relation projection is static. O(n log n + sum of keys times log policy size), with constant/empty probes understood, replaces the unsupported linear claim. DuplicateDigest is appropriately a host-invariant refusal for a host-built authenticated set, rather than an excluded-form refusal. Implementation must use checked arithmetic and index conversion, preserve empty/singleton behavior, allocate no hidden sorting scratch, and exercise the independently enumerated before-work exhaustion controls; this review does not establish implemented accounting.
rulings.Q2: Accepted. Preserve Budget, Io and each applicable corruption cause across the factory. Under CI r5 item 8, Absent uses DELIVERY.CLOSURE_BYTES_MISSING durably; the other promised-tree corruption causes use DELIVERY.CLOSURE_BYTES_CORRUPT durably; ephemeral corruption uses HOST.IO_FAILURE without detail. Observation Io is HOST.IO_FAILURE without detail and budget exhaustion keeps row 11 WORK.BUDGET_EXHAUSTED under SYSTEM.OUTCOME.ILLEGAL_STATE/host-invariant. SpecInconsistent keeps row 2 and its operational-record key. Keeping the typed cause beside OwnerRoute is necessary because OwnerRoute::ClosureBytesCorrupt alone cannot distinguish missing bytes or ephemeral detail policy. X-D4P-5 correctly gates J2 projection on the missing J1 matrix record rather than inventing a code or treating Io as corruption. The factory-level failure controls resolve RF-2 at plan level.
rulings.Q3: Accepted. A static sorted unique relation/rung projection, tested for exact equality against the embedded matrix projection, needs no runtime construction charge. At the specified product base the allowed projection has nine pairs: three syntax, five semantic and one unresolved-edge pair. Inventory and clones-fact are fact authority; clones-near and clones-cross-tsjs are candidate-only and have no relation pairs. Retain explicit controls for those excluded capability identities, since absence of their empty relation lists alone does not exercise a negative pair. CMS remains the authority over representable declarations; the table is a backstop, not broader provider authorization.
rulings.Q4: Accepted within the stated operation and sole-constructor discipline. Recheck every closure path named by LaunchSpec, including node, empty OpenSSL configuration and provider entry for TS2, or provider executable and toolchain directory for Rust3. Join each returned launch path and member identity to that exact spec path and its independently admitted closure; pass the actual executable recheck to VerifiedLaunch and reject any member failure before constructing it. Keep every corresponding capability/pin through spawn and child settlement, with the recheck last. D1a need not carry a whole member set merely for record completeness: the factory establishes the other member checks and the operation owns their lifetimes. This does not accept CI-A3, close its stated same-principal substitution window, or authorize a detached cached recheck. D4-4 waits for the accepted launch operation and its implementation (CI-3L), as well as its codec dependencies.
rulings.Q5: Accepted. Moving the exact reserved-name BTreeSet into ordinary-reader Evidence after validation preserves the authenticated policy without rebuilding or copying it. Borrow the retained set and charge the Vec<&str> slice view, its exact capacity, iteration and AdmissionPolicy order validation as specified. Keep the Evidence alive for the lend and compare the view with the retained set in controls. This changes the reader as well as the bridge, so the explicit D4-2 ordering after CI-2/CI-3 and its changed-path integration guard are appropriate.
